system.description:
This ancient, jagged sword glows with a pulsing green light. Damage Rating: 4

Critical Rating: 3 (2 on {Dc}) Qualities: None Group: Ordinary Encumbrance: 3 If the attacker’s dice pool generates one or more {Dm}, the Desolate Blade has a CR of 2, but the wielder suffers 1 fatigue and must make (To) an Average (2d) Resilience check or suffer 2 corruption. Each {Dc} rolled on this check also generates 1 corruption. Wielding this magical sword counts as having +1 Str.
